Motherboard.name: Silicon
Motherboard.reasoning: Silicon is the fundamental semiconductor material used in integrated circuits and chips that the motherboard hosts; it is absolutely essential for the motherboard's electronic function.

Motherboard.name: Copper
Motherboard.reasoning: Copper is universally used as the primary conductor in printed circuit boards and internal wiring of the motherboard due to its excellent electrical conductivity.

Motherboard.name: Tin
Motherboard.reasoning: Tin is used in solder alloys for component attachment on the motherboard, a standard industry practice with few substitutes.

Motherboard.name: Gold
Motherboard.reasoning: Gold is commonly used for reliable corrosion-resistant contacts and plating on connectors and critical contact points, though silver is sometimes an alternative.

Motherboard.name: Epoxy resins
Motherboard.reasoning: Epoxy resins form the PCB substrate and encapsulants, providing mechanical support and insulation, a standard and indispensable material.

Motherboard.name: Aluminum
Motherboard.reasoning: Aluminum may be used in some heat spreaders or structural parts of the motherboard assembly, but is not universally used and alternatives exist.

Lithium-ion Battery.name: Copper
Lithium-ion Battery.reasoning: Copper serves as the current collector for the anode and internal wiring, universally used in lithium-ion batteries.

Lithium-ion Battery.name: Aluminum
Lithium-ion Battery.reasoning: Aluminum is used as the cathode current collector and in battery casing materials, a very common standard.

Lithium-ion Battery.name: Graphite

Laptop Chassis.name: Aluminum

Laptop Chassis.name: Magnesium

Laptop Chassis.name: Steel Ingots

Cooling System.name: Copper
Cooling System.reasoning: Copper is widely used in heat pipes and heat sinks for its excellent thermal conductivity, an industry standard.

Cooling System.name: Aluminum
Cooling System.reasoning: Aluminum is also common in cooling fins and heat spreaders due to its good thermal conductivity and light weight.

Cooling System.name: Nickel

Cooling System.name: Graphite
